sentences.english: The girl has a book.
The friend sees the new book.
The girl calls her friend.
The friend praises the good girl.
The girl loves her friend.
The servant carries wine to the master.
The master has good wine.
The master gives the servant a small gift.
The servant sees the gift.
And so the servant loves the good master.
The wise judge has just laws.
The judge tells the people the truth.
The people believe the wise judge.
The just judge protects the people's freedom.
And so the just judge is praised by the people.
sentences.latin: Itaque iūdex iūstus ā populō laudātur.

sentences.english: The fierce commander leads the strong legion of soldiers into the great battle.
sentences.latin: Imperātor ferōx legiōnem mīlitum fortem in proelium magnum dūcit.

sentences.english: The strong legion of the fierce commander attacks the enemies.
sentences.latin: Legiō fortis imperātōris ferōcis hostēs petit.

sentences.english: The legion's great victory frightens the fierce enemies.
sentences.latin: Victōria magna legiōnis hostēs ferōcēs terret.

sentences.english: And so the fierce commander gives great gifts to the legion's soldiers.
sentences.latin: Itaque imperātor ferōx mīlitibus legiōnis dōna magna dat.

sentences.english: The fierce commander is praised by the strong legion.
sentences.latin: Imperātor ferōx ā legiōne fortī laudātur.
